# HDiffPatch Android SDK

Upstream release is v5.1.3 from https://github.com/sisong/HDiffPatch/releases/tag/v5.1.3 .

The SDK archive SHA-256 is `d7b98bcd3efb05436e08bcf525136c81e7dc6713bc58260770a2793818167fb7`.

The bundled JNI library and `com.github.sisong.HPatch` Java binding are unmodified upstream files. The upstream license is included beside this file. Android binaries use 16 KB ELF segment alignment. ToWork emits single-stream HDIFFSF20 patches with zlib compression.
